The '''Green Mist''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|tavern]] located near the primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lamuir IV]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. The [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Gotspar]] tended the bar at the establishment.
